guides.title: Build a weapon-material farming plan
guides.description: Separate ascension drops, enemy materials, enhancement ore and Mora.
guides.keywords: genshin weapon ascension domain forgery blacksmith mora upgrade 原神 武器 突破 素材 摩拉
guides.needs: An owned weapon and access to its upgrade screen.
guides.quick: Check the exact missing material before choosing a farming activity.
steps: Open the weapon upgrade screen and note the missing materials and Mora.
For ascension drops, check the relevant Domain of Forgery and its daily schedule.
Use the Crafting Bench if you already own lower-rarity materials from the same family.
For enemy drops, track the required enemy with the Adventurer’s Handbook.
Prepare enhancement ore through the Blacksmith; use Expeditions to gather supporting resources.
If Mora is the blocker, choose a Blossom of Wealth, commissions or available quests. Return and review the upgrade cost.
guides.success: Your selected upgrade has a clear source for every missing resource.

troubleshooting.solution: Check today’s rotation before spending Resin.

troubleshooting.problem: Enough enemy drops, but upgrade still blocked
troubleshooting.solution: Review the separate ore, ascension-material and Mora requirements.

guides.trouble: Wrong domain reward: Check today’s rotation before spending Resin. Enough enemy drops, but upgrade still blocked: Review the separate ore, ascension-material and Mora requirements.
guides.note: Domain rotations and recipes should be read in your current client. This is a resource workflow, not a recommended weapon ranking.

guides.title: Remove a quest that blocks Co-op
guides.description: Find the blocking quest instead of repeatedly sending invitations.
guides.keywords: genshin coop multiplayer blocked quest 原神 連線 多人 任務 限制
guides.needs: An account where Co-op has already been unlocked.
guides.quick: The multiplayer warning can name the quest that must be completed.
steps: Choose the multiplayer icon or attempt to enter Co-op.
Read the warning and record the quest name it identifies.
Open the quest list and finish that blocking quest or required stage.
If an event or challenge is active, finish the current portion.
Leave any event-vendor scene, teleport elsewhere and retry Co-op.
If access remains blocked, send Support the error, quest progress and a screenshot through the help interface.
guides.success: The blocking warning disappears and the multiplayer menu becomes available.

troubleshooting.problem: The same quest is still named
troubleshooting.solution: Check whether its current stage is fully completed.

troubleshooting.problem: No named quest or a different error
troubleshooting.solution: Capture the exact message; this guide does not diagnose account or network restrictions.

guides.trouble: The same quest is still named: Check whether its current stage is fully completed. No named quest or a different error: Capture the exact message; this guide does not diagnose account or network restrictions.
guides.note: This addresses temporary quest/event blocks, not the initial Co-op unlock or every possible connection error.

guides.title: Start Temporary Acclimatization
guides.description: Check both prerequisites before searching for Woliu.
guides.keywords: genshin temporary acclimatization woliu chenyu yilong quest 原神 暫行適應 任務 沉玉谷
guides.needs: Access to Chenyu Vale and Fontaine.
guides.quick: Complete the required Chenyu and Fontaine quests, then speak with Woliu at Yilong Wharf.
steps: Check progress in Chenyu’s Blessings of Sunken Jade.
Finish its required part, Qiaoying of the Sacred Mountain.
Near the Opera Epiclese in Fontaine, check the quest In Expert Company? (II).
Complete In Expert Company? (II); merely accepting it is insufficient.
Travel to Yilong Wharf in Chenyu Vale.
Find Woliu near the pavilion and speak with her to start Temporary Acclimatization.
guides.success: Temporary Acclimatization begins and its objective appears.

troubleshooting.solution: Recheck both prerequisite completions, including part II in Fontaine.
The start is Yilong Wharf in Chenyu Vale, not the Opera Epiclese.

guides.trouble: Woliu offers no quest: Recheck both prerequisite completions, including part II in Fontaine. At the wrong harbour: The start is Yilong Wharf in Chenyu Vale, not the Opera Epiclese.
guides.note: This guide covers unlocking the quest only; it is not a walkthrough of every later objective.

guides.title: Collect and restart Assignments
guides.description: Make the passive material routine easy to check.
guides.keywords: hsr assignments materials claim all redispatch 崩鐵 委託 素材 領取
guides.version: Claim All workflow documented in Version 2.1
guides.quick: Review your stock, claim finished returns and redispatch deliberately.
steps: Open Assignments.
Inspect the material stock shown for the assignments you use.
Check which returns are ready.
Choose Claim All to collect completed returns.
Use the redispatch option, then confirm which assignments are running.
guides.success: Collected materials are reflected in stock and the intended assignments are running.

troubleshooting.solution: Check completion state instead of assuming materials were lost.
Review the selected assignment before redispatching.

guides.trouble: Nothing to claim: Check completion state instead of assuming materials were lost. Wrong materials keep arriving: Review the selected assignment before redispatching.
guides.note: Menu wording may evolve. No fixed assignment duration, capacity or reward quantity is assumed.
guides.sourceName: Honkai: Star Rail · Version 2.1 system notes

guides.title: Review a Relic set with Smart Equip
guides.description: Adjust individual slots before accepting an automatic suggestion.
guides.keywords: hsr relic smart equip equipment stats 崩鐵 遺器 智慧 裝備
guides.version: Smart Equip workflow documented in Version 3.5
guides.needs: Owned Relics and access to Character > Relics.
guides.quick: Smart Equip is a starting point; compare every replacement with your intended build.
steps: Open the character you want to equip.
Choose Relics, then Smart Equip.
Review the suggested pieces and their main stats.
Select individual slots to replace pieces you do not want.
Check selected pieces, which are marked and prioritized in recommendations.
Apply the choice and inspect the resulting equipment. The panel stays open for further adjustments.
guides.success: The character is wearing the pieces you reviewed.

troubleshooting.solution: Review selected or prioritized pieces and replace the affected slot.

troubleshooting.problem: Recommendation does not suit your team
troubleshooting.solution: Compare the character’s abilities and your own build goal; automatic suggestions are not a universal best build.

guides.trouble: An unwanted piece keeps appearing: Review selected or prioritized pieces and replace the affected slot. Recommendation does not suit your team: Compare the character’s abilities and your own build goal; automatic suggestions are not a universal best build.
guides.note: Version 3.5 also merged Wishful Resin into Self-Modeling Resin. Older crafting instructions may therefore show an obsolete resource.
guides.sourceName: Honkai: Star Rail · Version 3.5 equipment changes

sourceLinks.label: Honkai: Star Rail · Version 3.5 equipment changes

guides.title: Request eligible salvaged equipment back
guides.description: Use the built-in retrieval form after an accidental salvage.
guides.keywords: hsr lost relic light cone salvage retrieve recovery 崩鐵 遺器 光錐 回收 找回
guides.needs: An accidentally salvaged 5-star Relic or 4-star Light Cone.
guides.quick: Open Smartphone > Bug Report > Relic/Light Cone Salvage Retrieval and check eligibility.
steps: Confirm whether the lost item was salvaged and check its rarity.
Open the Smartphone menu.
Choose Bug Report.
Open Relic/Light Cone Salvage Retrieval.
Read its current retrieval rules and conditions.
If eligible, complete the in-game request and check its result before assuming recovery.
guides.success: You have an eligibility result or a submitted retrieval request.

troubleshooting.solution: Check the form’s current conditions; recovery is not guaranteed.
This help article only establishes the named salvage categories. Use normal Support for other cases.

guides.trouble: Item is not listed: Check the form’s current conditions; recovery is not guaranteed. Different rarity or loss method: This help article only establishes the named salvage categories. Use normal Support for other cases.
guides.note: The guide does not promise unlimited recovery or invent a retrieval deadline.

guides.title: Craft and use a Java shield
guides.description: Protect the front of your character and understand the limits.
guides.keywords: minecraft java shield crafting blocking defend 盾牌 合成 防禦
guides.version: Java shield controls · default mouse input
guides.needs: A crafting table, six planks and one iron ingot.
guides.quick: Craft the shield, face the attack and hold Use Item to block.
steps: Open a crafting table’s 3 × 3 grid.
Place six planks in a Y pattern, with one iron ingot in the top-middle gap.
Collect the shield and hold it for a simple first test.
Face the direction of the incoming attack.
Hold Use Item, normally right-click in Java, to raise it.
Check durability afterwards; repair with planks at an anvil when appropriate.
guides.success: The shield raises and blocks a blockable attack from the front.

troubleshooting.solution: Check facing; not every attack is blockable and axes can disable shields.
Check Java’s Use Item binding and that you are holding the shield.

guides.trouble: Damage still gets through: Check facing; not every attack is blockable and axes can disable shields. Shield does not raise: Check Java’s Use Item binding and that you are holding the shield.
guides.note: These are Java mouse controls. Bedrock blocking controls differ. Repair cost and remaining durability should be checked in-game.

guides.title: Use a Blast Furnace for metal processing
guides.description: Choose the right furnace for the item you want to smelt.
guides.keywords: minecraft blast furnace smelt iron metal fuel 高爐 熔爐 冶煉
guides.needs: Five iron ingots, three smooth stone, one furnace and suitable fuel.
guides.quick: A Blast Furnace processes eligible metal items faster; it does not replace every furnace recipe.
steps: Use a crafting table and put three smooth stone across the bottom row.
Place the furnace in the centre and fill the remaining five slots with iron ingots.
Place the completed Blast Furnace in your base.
Open it and add an eligible ore or metal equipment item to process.
Add fuel and wait for the progress indicator to finish.
Take the output. Use a normal furnace for recipes the Blast Furnace does not accept.
guides.success: The selected eligible input produces its smelted output.

troubleshooting.solution: Check both fuel and whether the input belongs in a Blast Furnace.
It burns fuel faster as it works faster; fuel per item is not improved.

guides.trouble: Nothing starts: Check both fuel and whether the input belongs in a Blast Furnace. Fuel does not last longer: It burns fuel faster as it works faster; fuel per item is not improved.
guides.note: Official documentation describes double processing speed. Modded recipes can change eligibility.
guides.sourceName: Minecraft · Block of the Week: Blast Furnace

sourceLinks.label: Minecraft · Block of the Week: Blast Furnace

guides.title: Navigate back toward world spawn
guides.description: A normal compass points to world spawn, not automatically to your bed.
guides.keywords: minecraft compass spawn lost navigation redstone 指南針 出生點 迷路
guides.version: Ordinary compass; excludes lodestone and recovery compasses
guides.needs: Four iron ingots, one redstone dust and a crafting table.
guides.quick: Follow the red needle in the Overworld, while choosing a safe route around obstacles.
steps: Put redstone dust in the crafting grid’s centre.
Place an iron ingot above, below, left and right of it.
Take the ordinary compass and enter the Overworld.
Observe the red needle and turn toward its direction.
Travel safely in that direction, checking the needle as you move.
Use known landmarks near world spawn to locate your destination.
guides.success: You move back toward the world’s spawn area.

troubleshooting.problem: Compass does not lead to my house
troubleshooting.solution: It targets world spawn; sleeping in a bed does not make it a home locator.
A normal compass is not a reliable route guide in other dimensions.

guides.trouble: Compass does not lead to my house: It targets world spawn; sleeping in a bed does not make it a home locator. Needle behaves strangely: A normal compass is not a reliable route guide in other dimensions.
guides.note: This is not a pathfinding tool. A base away from spawn needs a separate navigation method.

guides.title: Move a PC Story save to Enhanced
guides.description: Check the one-time transfer before downloading the save.
guides.keywords: gta v legacy enhanced story save migrate transfer PC 存檔 轉移
guides.version: Rockstar PC migration workflow; no console transfer
guides.needs: Both PC editions and the correct linked Rockstar account.
guides.quick: Upload from Legacy; download in Enhanced only after checking the selected save.
steps: Confirm that the signed-in Rockstar account is linked to your intended PC platform account.
In Legacy, open Pause > Game > Upload Save Game.
Select the intended Story save and confirm its upload.
Wait for the successful-upload message.
Open Enhanced and choose Pause > Game > Download Save Game.
Check the selected save before confirming; a successful download uses this account’s Story migration.
Wait for confirmation and check the loaded progress.
guides.success: Enhanced loads the intended Story progress.

troubleshooting.solution: Uploads remain available for 90 days; an expired upload may need uploading again.

troubleshooting.problem: Expecting later Legacy progress to appear
troubleshooting.solution: Progress is not synced after migration.
This workflow only supports PC Legacy to PC Enhanced.

guides.trouble: Save is missing: Uploads remain available for 90 days; an expired upload may need uploading again. Expecting later Legacy progress to appear: Progress is not synced after migration. Using a console save: This workflow only supports PC Legacy to PC Enhanced.
guides.note: One uploaded save per account. Once downloaded successfully, further Story migrations are unavailable on that account. Eligibility restrictions can apply.
guides.sourceName: Rockstar Support · PC Story save migration

sourceLinks.label: Rockstar Support · PC Story save migration

guides.title: Reduce intense first-person camera movement
guides.description: Tune camera behaviour in Story Mode before a long session.
guides.keywords: gta camera first person head bobbing cover settings 視角 設定 第一人稱
guides.version: First-person settings; platform menus can differ
guides.needs: An edition with First Person Mode.
guides.quick: Reduce head movement and choose whether cover should use third person.
steps: Open Settings > Controls and locate the first-person options.
Turn First Person Head Bobbing off if running movement feels distracting.
Turn First Person Ragdoll off to reduce forced first-person motion when hit.
Turn First Person Combat Rolls off if rolling movement is uncomfortable.
Set First Person Third Person Cover on if you prefer a wider view while using cover.
Return to play and test walking, jogging and cover; adjust one setting at a time.
guides.success: Camera movement and cover perspective match your preference.

troubleshooting.solution: Recheck the specific cover option, rather than only the overall camera mode.
Confirm your edition supports first person; the original PS3/Xbox 360 versions do not use this feature set.

guides.trouble: Cover still stays first person: Recheck the specific cover option, rather than only the overall camera mode. Option missing: Confirm your edition supports first person; the original PS3/Xbox 360 versions do not use this feature set.
guides.note: These are comfort preferences, not a guaranteed performance or aiming improvement. Use your edition’s displayed menu labels.
guides.sourceName: Rockstar Game Tips · Playing with Perspective

sourceLinks.label: Rockstar Game Tips · Playing with Perspective

guides.title: Improve the character you actually use
guides.description: Training belongs to each protagonist separately.
guides.keywords: gta shooting stat range skill training story 射擊 技能 練習
guides.quick: Train the intended protagonist; progress is not shared between Michael, Franklin and Trevor.
steps: Switch to the protagonist you want to improve.
Check that character’s Shooting stat.
Visit an available Shooting Range.
Follow a shooting challenge and focus on accurate hits.
Compare the same character’s stat after practice.
guides.success: You can track training on the intended character.

troubleshooting.solution: Skills are separate for each character.
Review aiming settings as well as the skill stat.

guides.trouble: Another protagonist did not improve: Skills are separate for each character. Handling still feels poor: Review aiming settings as well as the skill stat.
guides.note: Practice can improve accuracy, reload speed and ammunition capacity. No fixed training time is promised.

guides.title: Turn Department missions into an upgrade plan
guides.description: Connect the mission reward to your next useful unlock.
guides.keywords: delta operations department black site upgrade supply station 三角洲 部門 黑市 升級
guides.version: Department, Supply Station and Black Site progression
guides.quick: Check an unlock requirement before choosing your next Department mission.
steps: Inspect the Supply Station item or Black Site upgrade you want.
Note any Department-level requirement.
Open that Department and read available mission objectives.
Choose a mission you can complete with your available equipment.
Finish it, collect its reward and recheck the unlock requirement.
guides.success: You know which mission advances your selected unlock.

troubleshooting.solution: Compare the required Department level with your current level.
Review its remaining requirements; Department progress is not the only possible condition.

guides.trouble: Item is still locked: Compare the required Department level with your current level. Upgrade still unavailable: Review its remaining requirements; Department progress is not the only possible condition.
guides.note: Based on Garena documentation; check regional-client requirements. No universal mission order is claimed.

guides.title: Compare a gun build in the Firing Range
guides.description: Test one change before applying a trial loadout.
guides.keywords: delta gunsmith firing range calibrate preview attachments recoil 三角洲 改槍 靶場 後座力
guides.needs: Access to Gunsmith and the Firing Range.
guides.quick: Keep a baseline, try one change, then decide whether to apply the trial build.
steps: Open the weapon in Gunsmith and note its starting configuration.
Change one compatible attachment so the comparison stays clear.
Use Preview Mode’s Calibrate option if relevant.
Enter the Firing Range and test the handling at a consistent distance.
Return to Gunsmith; the documented workflow preserves the trial configuration.
Choose whether to apply the trial loadout, then check the final equipment before deploying.
guides.success: You have chosen a configuration after testing its handling.

troubleshooting.solution: Confirm whether you applied the trial loadout.
Check the weapon’s compatibility and requirements instead of assuming every attachment fits.

guides.trouble: Build looks different after leaving: Confirm whether you applied the trial loadout. Attachment will not fit: Check the weapon’s compatibility and requirements instead of assuming every attachment fits.
guides.note: This is a comparison routine, not a meta ranking. Balance values and regional features may change; inspect your current client.

guides.title: Cross water without exhausting oxygen
guides.description: Plan where to surface before entering a long swim.
guides.keywords: delta swimming diving oxygen stamina operations 三角洲 游泳 潛水 氧氣
guides.version: Swimming rules documented in Season Break
guides.needs: A map with water and a planned exit point.
guides.quick: Watch oxygen underwater; sprint swimming spends resources faster.
steps: Identify a nearby shore or place where you can surface.
Enter the water and use slower movement when conserving resources.
Watch oxygen while diving; do not wait until it runs out.
Resurface to restore oxygen.
Use weapons only from the surface; they cannot fire underwater.
After the match, inspect the Black Site Diving Center for swimming-related upgrades.
guides.success: You reach your exit without losing HP to depleted oxygen.

troubleshooting.solution: Surface: empty oxygen causes health loss.
Underwater weapon fire is unavailable; only certain gadgets work there.

guides.trouble: HP drains underwater: Surface: empty oxygen causes health loss. Gun will not fire: Underwater weapon fire is unavailable; only certain gadgets work there.
guides.note: Sprinting drains Stamina and oxygen faster. Garena’s July 2025 documentation is the source; compare your current service.
